Dear Hiring Manager,

I read that at IWG so many of your senior leaders started their careers in your centres, and that is exactly the kind of place I want to join. I have spent years working directly with people: as a tango instructor in Türkiye I taught classes and ran the studio's daily operations, from the first class of the day through to closing, handling every task the studio needed however big or small. That is the same warm, hands-on, can-do work your Customer Services Executive role describes.

Today I work in digital marketing, where I welcome clients, run discovery meetings and take ownership of their results, including a self-funded Google Ads test that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. I bring great communication, a positive attitude and the determination to be better tomorrow than today.

I live in Zwijndrecht near Antwerp and have my own car, so getting to your Brussels location is no problem. I would love to talk about how I can help your customers and colleagues have a great day at work.

Baver Ok

Dear Hiring Manager,

I read that at IWG so many of your most senior leaders started their careers in your centres, and that is exactly the kind of place I want to join. I have spent years working directly with people: as a tango instructor in Türkiye I taught classes and ran the studio's daily operations, from the first class of the day through to closing, handling every task the studio needed however big or small. That is the same warm, hands-on, can-do work your Customer Services Executive role describes.

Today I work in digital marketing, where I welcome clients, run discovery meetings and take ownership of their results. I brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal for them. I also ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks, and I built around 600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association. Every one of those projects started with listening to what a customer actually needed and then making it happen.

What appeals to me about IWG is that you are almost 4,000 tech-enabled, sustainable locations worldwide and still growing, and you are clear that your people are the reason. I bring great communication skills, a positive and outgoing attitude, and the determination to be better tomorrow than today. I take direction well, learn new skills quickly and apply them with confidence.

I live in Zwijndrecht near Antwerp and have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem.

In my first weeks I would get to know your customers and their guests by name, learn the on-site tasks that keep a busy workspace running smoothly, and make sure every person who walks in feels genuinely welcome. I would like to talk about how I can help your customers and colleagues have a great day at work.

cv_text:
# Baver Ok
Customer-focused · People-first · Tango instructor · Daily client interaction
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | [+32 470 42 48 36](tel:+32470424836) | [baverok@gmail.com](mailto:baverok@gmail.com)
[linkedin.com/in/baverok](https://www.linkedin.com/in/baverok) | [baverok.com](https://baverok.com) | 02-04-1994
English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
I bring a people-first approach to every role, shaped by years of teaching tango and running a studio's daily operations, where I welcomed students, built trust and took ownership from opening to closing. As a digital marketer I work directly with clients, leading discovery meetings, presenting results and selling services with a free site check as the first step. I am outgoing, analytical and eager to learn, and I want to bring that energy to a team where helping customers and colleagues have a great day is the core of the job.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present
- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation
- Brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media
- **4.57% CTR and 53 clicks** from a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands for a kids' bike brand: built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026
- Delivered client websites end to end, from site structure and content to social media integration
- Analysed SEO performance and reported results to clients with Search Console and Google Analytics

### Tango Instructor – Türkiye, 2015 – 2018
- Taught tango classes and ran the studio's daily operations, from the first class of the day through to closing
- Handled every task the studio needed alongside teaching, however big or small

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

## SKILLS
- **Growth & sales:** client discovery meetings, lead generation, offers and proposals, landing pages, A/B testing
- **SEO & marketing:** SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, AI search (GEO/AEO), Google Ads Search, content marketing, WooCommerce
- **Data & tools:** GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, WordPress/Elementor, HTML/CSS, Odoo, Canva, Claude/ChatGPT

## EDUCATION
- Applied Computer Science (coursework) – Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp, 2022 – 2025
- Computer Science (coursework) – Celal Bayar University, Türkiye, 2012 – 2016

## CERTIFICATIONS
- [Semrush Academy – SEO Fundamentals](https://static.semrush.com/academy/certificates/7b2509a083/baver-ok_25.pdf) (2026)
- [Semrush Academy – SEO Toolkit](https://static.semrush.com/academy/certificates/35c1af233e/baver-ok_25.pdf) (2026)
